none: PAS LON-5E4525: Roman coin: nummus of Constantine I or II
contea di ritrovamento: Essex (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy coin: nummus of Constantine I or II dated AD321-323. Reverse: BEATA TRANQVILLITAS. Reece period 16. Mint: Lyon. Obverse: Helmetted and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: CONS[TANTINOPOLIS]. Reverse: Globe on altar inscribed [V]O[TI]S XX. Reverse inscription: [BEATA TRAN]QVILLITAS (Blessed tranquillity). Mint mark: [-]/R//PLG. Die axis measurement: 12.00. Dimensions: diameter: 18.87mm; weight: 1.50g
